title: pm-dispatch(triage): a lane seat may self-triage at p1/p2 a card that blocks its own in-flight work on clear evidence, in triage's format, and triage reviews it each round
body:
Fixes #27061
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:车道席遇到一张还没分诊、却挡住自己在飞工作(认领卡、其 PR、队列落地、拆分链)的卡,可以自己先做首触、定 p1/p2 —— 前提是卡上引了具名证据(失败 check/run、复现读数或 pin 测试);记录照分诊格式贴在卡上、行首 `Ruling-ref:` 引你的原话,然后请分诊复审;分诊每轮逐条确认或改判,复审前席位的定级有效。`SKILL.md` 里「队列与级别只由分诊落笔」的两行改为指向这个例外。
- 为什么改:你的裁决「照此执行,并立卡更新 skills」—— 规则已在 server 车道生效,写进技能文本让每个车道席读到同一段话;其它卡照旧全部走分诊。
- 风险与回滚:只改两份协议文本(`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`),无代码、无门禁、无发布面;回滚 = revert 本 PR。付行的四条删行各有具名的家(下表),误删与否在那张表上可核。
- 先看:`references/triage-duties.md` L30–33(新例外四行)与 L24(合并行);`SKILL.md` L170–171(指针两行;L34 红线未动)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` —— 预期看到 `triage-duties.md is 102 lines (ceiling 102; headroom 0)` 与 `SKILL.md is 319 lines (ceiling 319; headroom 0)`,且每条散文行 ≤120 B。
- 需要你做的:无,席位达档复核(Tier S,`.claude/**`)后落地。

## What changes

Two files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`, both already at their line ceilings; net 0 lines in each, every prose line at or under 120 bytes, no table row added (the triage-duties widest-row pin stays at 0). The card's four Wanted items and triage's own grade (6460243271, the per-round review) map onto the text as follows.

**`references/triage-duties.md` (102 → 102).** The four new lines sit directly after the main-red block (old L28–30: 紧急卡直接分诊 · main-red 锚卡由席位先立先派 · 主干全量红…首触定 p0), the file's existing "a seat acts first, triage follows" cluster, so the ⛔ p0 pointer in the third new line reads two lines up. The dispatch order suggested the 在飞/释放 block (old L75–78) and the 复审 block (L11/L16); the line the card quoted as L75 left the file before this PR, and the live analogue of the mechanism is the main-red block, so the four lines are kept contiguous there (declared as a deviation in the report).

## Tests

No package is touched, so there is no ① build closure and no package test suite is owed; the two files are protocol text and their tests are the gate families under Verification. No tested behaviour changed, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- Placement: the four triage-duties lines are contiguous after the main-red block rather than split between the 在飞/释放 block and the 复审 block the order suggested (reason above); the seat may move L33 next to L11/L16 at zero cost if it prefers the 复审 block.
- `Ruling-ref:` words: the skill text names the ruling without quoting it (the corpus carries no quotations or issue numbers; `check:pm-skill-id-lint`). The three maintainer lines a seat quotes on its record live verbatim on the card this PR closes, reachable from this PR and from `git log -S` on L32.
- Lane charters still carry the old absolute for their own lane and are outside this card's two-file scope: `lanes/skills.md` L22 「本车道 finding 同走分诊席首触,⛔ 不自分诊」, `lanes/spec.md` L29 「findings 首触定级归分诊席,本席只供证据」, `lanes/ui.md` L8 「⛔ 不产 `domain:*`、type 与定级,分诊唯一生产」. A reader of one of those alone does not find the exception; carrier: the skills seat (its lane charters) — noted, not filed.
- `execution-duties.md` L11 「无分诊审计评论即非候选」 reads unchanged on purpose: a self-triage record in triage's format is that audit comment, which is also why `SKILL.md` L171 keeps 「无分诊审计评论 ⛔ 不得认领」 beside the new exception.

The build changed no tracked file.
